title: MediaArtifact.v1
description: Output metadata contract for any generated media artifact (audio, video, image). Attached to invocation receipts and used for machine-verifiable acceptance testing.

media_type.description: MIME type of the generated artifact.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the artifact file.

duration_seconds.description: Duration for audio/video artifacts. Null for images.

sample_rate.description: Audio sample rate in Hz (e.g. 24000, 44100). Null for video-only or images.

channels.description: Number of audio channels. Null for video-only or images.

voice_ids.description: Physical Kokoro voice ids that rendered this audio, in host_a, host_b order. Null for non-podcast artifacts.

voice_source.description: Where those voices came from: the PodcastScript contract's speaker voice_id, the named VoiceProfile, or one of each.

video_width.description: Video frame width in pixels. Null for audio-only.

video_height.description: Video frame height in pixels. Null for audio-only.

video_fps.description: Video frame rate. Null for audio-only.

codec.description: Primary codec name (e.g. mp3, aac, h264, av1).

file_size_bytes.description: Size of the artifact file in bytes.

peak_dedicated_vram_bytes.description: Peak dedicated VRAM usage during generation. Null for CPU-only tasks.

peak_shared_vram_bytes.description: Peak shared (system RAM) VRAM usage during generation.

generation_duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock time in seconds for the generation step.

trace_id.description: Root OpenTelemetry trace ID linking this artifact to the AM4 Jaeger trace tree.

source_contract_schema.description: Schema identifier of the input contract that produced this artifact (e.g. mediagen.podcast-script.v1).
